related_unstructured_treatment_source.title: Causal Inference with Unstructured Treatments
related_unstructured_treatment_source.used_for: limited cross-check of unstructured-treatment extension vocabulary

headline_verdict.summary: Use MCF-style scoring only as a constrained post-measurement contrast report over existing persisted decoded/argmax/margin/edge fields; never as score authority or archive ranking currency.

recall_evidence.query: #931 na3 prefix bias sign inversion subset selection
recall_evidence.finding: Prefix subsets are not exchangeable with the population; pose prefixes are 2.54x to 4.21x harder while seg prefixes are modestly easier; n8 banks nothing.
recall_evidence.plan_impact: HTE/stratum claims require explicit selection mode, seed/stride, denominators, and population-ratio checks.

recall_evidence.finding: Per-edge accounting is load-bearing; Road<->Lane carries 49.2% of flips and Road-incident edges carry 87.8%.
recall_evidence.plan_impact: MCF feature families should be edge/verb keyed rather than class-only.

recall_evidence.finding: Existing atlas persists typed n600 pair/frame score-debt fields and hard-pair diagnostics; it is advisory and non-promotable.
recall_evidence.plan_impact: CI1 consumes existing atlas fields; it does not request a new scorer pass.

recall_evidence.finding: Per-pixel misplacement and margin-saliency instruments are already diagnostic/loss-weighting assets, never authority.
recall_evidence.plan_impact: MCF reports must carry provenance and authority labels for consumed fields.

recall_evidence.finding: The charter's 1.56 beta2 time-constant statement is superseded by ddm_na2's correction to 3.00 tau; the verdict remains underpowered because it is n=1, diagonal-only, non-independent, and dose-confounded.
recall_evidence.plan_impact: Identification failure is recorded as exchangeability/dose/control incompleteness, not the stale 1.56-tau duration.

recall_evidence.query: canonical equations margin stratum score quotient
recall_evidence.finding: Existing canonical equation ids cover this crosswalk.

seed_verdicts.conclusion: Specify a constrained MCF-style contrast report over existing persisted feature fields; existing instruments already provide most fixed maps.
seed_verdicts.falsifier: If existing g3/mp1/force-ledger outputs already reproduce the same maximum-contrast feature with provenance, the wrapper is redundant; if the selected feature has no exact argmax/margin change, it is folded.

seed_verdicts.conclusion: Use covariate-dependent scoring to require edge/verb/pair/margin/axis/selection-mode strata before aggregate claims; it does not lower n floors.
seed_verdicts.falsifier: If stratified random n120 still sign-inverts outside declared null bands, or if features are selected post hoc without predeclared families/cross-fitting, fold the design.

seed_verdicts.conclusion: Existing gates encode most hygiene; add an explicit assumption row naming exchangeability basis, overlap, receiver consistency, and hidden dose variables.
seed_verdicts.falsifier: A matched A/B with same checkpoint, selection, seed policy, window, dose variables, and required controls still shows the contrast.

seed_verdicts.conclusion: MCF learned scalars are diagnostics only, never score authority, promotion evidence, or archive ranking currency.
seed_verdicts.falsifier: Only an official contest-oracle rule change can supersede this boundary.

seed_verdicts.conclusion: Pact treatments are mostly structured DSL flags and archive programs; unstructured-treatment ideas transfer only as modifiability/overlap caution.
seed_verdicts.falsifier: A future genuinely unstructured treatment with reproducible treatment provenance and overlap checks can reopen the extension.

identification_crosswalk.pact_failure_mode: Different parent checkpoint, seed, window, runtime state, or hidden effective dose between treatment/control arms.
identification_crosswalk.existing_apparatus: reset-race DSL, optimizer-state gate, confound gates, L3 clearance
identification_crosswalk.cheap_cure: receipt row naming exchangeability_basis with checkpoint, seed, window, selection, and dose variables

identification_crosswalk.pact_failure_mode: A stratum exists in one arm but not the other, or a prefix samples a scene block instead of the population.
identification_crosswalk.existing_apparatus: subset selector, subset gate, NA3 anti-patterns
identification_crosswalk.cheap_cure: per-stratum denominators and population-ratio checks before reading treatment effect

identification_crosswalk.pact_failure_mode: Receiver/archive changes redefine the outcome unit.
identification_crosswalk.existing_apparatus: receiver parse-back, byte-close receipts, force-ledger magnitude kinds
identification_crosswalk.cheap_cure: require shared receiver grammar and decoded-unit definition for treatment/control

identification_crosswalk.pact_failure_mode: Diagnostic feature chases treatment-specific artifacts unrelated to scorer cells.
identification_crosswalk.existing_apparatus: exact scorer authority boundary and margin/argmax checks
identification_crosswalk.cheap_cure: predeclare feature families and cross-fit or report on held-out/already-measured fields

follow_ons.reason: Authority use invalid and existing instruments already cover the scorer-relevant fixed maps.

follow_ons.fire_order: After a completed matched A/B has persisted decoded/argmax/margin/edge fields, run a scorer-free contrast report over predeclared feature families. No frozen-scorer forward.

follow_ons.reason: Existing canonical equations cover this crosswalk and no new measurement/law was derived.
Use the corrected 3.00 beta2 tau and the existing ungrounded n=1 diagonal verdict.
subset_selection, subset_selection_gate, and NA3 anti-patterns already mechanize the cure.

canonical_equation_registration.reason: No new empirical law; CI1 maps onto existing canonical surfaces.

authority_boundary: MCF scalar scores are diagnostic projections only. They cannot rank archives, promote rows, replace frozen scorer cells, or move a pointer.
next_if_resumed: Refresh against full CI1 PDF if access becomes available.
Run a zero-scorer contrast receipt only over already persisted matched-A/B fields.
Reject any MCF score/promotion claim unless it points back to exact archive bytes and official scorer evidence.
